'''Master Satele's holocron''' was a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] created by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] sometime during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the subsequent [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The holocron consisted of two [[Color/Legends|bronze]] and gold octahedrons joined together by a silver ring.<ref name="Item" /> During the renewed war, Shan sent her holocron to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] after the [[Dromund Kaas operation|defeat]] of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], along with a note thanking the Hero for the Jedi's service to the Order and [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Letter" />

Master Satele's holocron first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. The holocron is a Rank 3 Republic Memorabilia gift that can be given to companion characters, and is only received by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] players who have completed Act III of their class storyline.<ref name="Letter" />
